content: उपरागः .²1 An eclipse of the sun or moon; उपरागान्ते शशिनः समुपगता रोहिणी योगम् <ls>Ś. 7. 22</ls>; <ls>Śi. 20. 45</ls>. .²2 Hence, Rāhu or the ascending node. .²3 Redness, red colour, colour; कोपोपरागजनिताम् <ls>Ratn. 3. 14</ls>; <ls>Mk. 4</ls>; कलहकोप˚ <ls>Māl. 9</ls>. .²4 A calamity, affliction, injury; blighting influence; मृणालिनी हैममिवोपरागम् <ls>R. 16. 7</ls>. .²5 Misbehaviour, ill-conduct. .²6 Reproach, blame, abuse.
